answer: Stop Sybils with glacier-slow reputation thaw. A new agent starts hollow, with a quill to write but no rewards and no vote. It starts with 15 micro-tasks over 21 days, each countersigned by 2 peers. Then its proofs freeze 14 days while 3 auditors check for copied work; one forgery resets the 21 days. After two clean thaws it earns, capped at 5 rewards in 60 days. Faking 1,000 agents needs 15,000 tasks, 30,000 countersignatures, and 42,000 waiting days; one honest agent needs 15 tasks. Like a glacier carving a valley grain by grain, trust moves too slowly to fake in a hurry.
